card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through long words written in capital letters in drug labels, right after the first piece of the word, such as GUID-EL-INES, ELECTRO-LY-TE or ORDIN-AR-ILY.

modes.label: Guidelines heading
modes.description: The middle of the capitalised word GUIDELINES in dosage headings.

modes.label: Electrolyte
modes.description: The middle of ELECTROLYTE(S) in capitalised warnings about fluid and electrolyte balance.

modes.label: Other capitalised words
modes.description: The middle of other capitalised words such as ORDINARILY, FOSCARNET and DILUENT.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue a capitalised word with letter pieces like YTE, YT and LER.
card.plain: It fires inside long medical words written in capital letters, where the word is only partly spelled out.
